text:
Nora: Flagging an SSO failure affecting a subset of Private VPC onboarding tenants. Customers reporting 401s when they try first-time SSO. Need comms + immediate mitigation options.

Aisha: Thanks Nora. Can we confirm how many tenants and which are high-touch (renewal risk)? Ken can triage renewals.

Tom: preliminary: 10 tenants impacted, 3 flagged as high-touch (enterprise trials). Error shows 'SAML assertion rejected' from our proxy layer. Collecting tenant ids now.

Ilya: investigating. Rolling back a recent IdP client change on staging to validate. If rollback looks good I'll push to prod. ETA 35m for staging + 25m to prod depending on approvals.

Priya: CS needs a one-paragraph status update for emails and an optional shorter note for Slack. Also want to schedule a 30-min office hours slot for any affected teams.

Marta: We'll need to surface enablement docs for workaround steps: how to enable a fallback email login flow and how to retrieve API keys temporarily. I can draft and publish a short KB.

Ken: I'll reach out directly to the 3 renewal-risk customers with a proactive note offering immediate help and a dedicated triage call. If outage >2 hours mark them for potential renewal credit discussion.

Nora: Draft status (email): "Weare addressing an SSO login issue affecting some Private VPC onboarding tenants. Our engineers are actively working on a fix and we expect to restore access shortly. If you need immediate access, we can enable a temporary email login or create an API key for your integration. If you'd like a dedicated troubleshooting call, reply to this message and we'll set it up." Keep?

Aisha: Good. Add: expected restoration timeframe (we'll say within the hour) and the contact path (support@redwood.ai + link to scheduled office hours). Remove root cause detail.

Nora: Updated: "...we expect to restore access within the hour. Contact support@redwood.ai or join office hours at 15:30 UTC for live help." Sending now to the affected tenant list.

Tom: Added a short-term retry backoff at the proxy so retries from tenant SDKs don't cascade. Also pushed increased logging for tenant ids to help triage.

Ilya: Rollback green on staging. Kicking prod deploy now; will watch error rate and auth success.

ops-bot: incident logged INC-2026-487, priority P2, incident owner Ilya.

Priya: CS checklist: 1) initial status email (Nora) 2) office hours 15:30 UTC (Marta hosting) 3) high-touch outreach (Ken) 4) capture feedback via short form in closure note (Priya) 5) tag renewal risk customers for potential credits (Aisha).

Marta: KB draft for workaround ready: includes steps to enable password fallback, how to request an API key, and a short script for SAML reconfiguration checks. I'll drop link after push.

Ilya: Prod rollback complete. Monitoring shows auth success for 8/10 tenants within 7 minutes. Two tenants still failing; opening support tickets and reaching out to their engineers.

Aisha: Keep a running list of any asks for credits or contract implications. Ken will compile and escalate.

Tom: Follow-up: cleared stale KV session entries for affected routes and rotated a short-lived debug token we used during verification.

Nora: Office hours invite sent. Initial status broadcast delivered to the affected contacts. One high-touch customer requested an immediate call and Ken is on it.

Priya: I'll create the feedback capture form (3 questions: impact severity, features blocked, ask for remediation). Will include link in closure message.

Ilya: All tenants now authenticating successfully. Logs show no residual 401 spikes. I'll prepare an RCA draft and post to incident channel within 3 hours for review.

Aisha: After RCA review we'll send post-incident customer note + the feedback link and offer credit consideration if impact >2hrs. Thanks team. Please tag me on any customers requesting escalation. :thumbsup:
